Overview of the Upcoming Special

Fans of the supernatural comedy series can look forward to a special double-episode event. The Ghosts season 6 Halloween Special arrives as a one-hour, two-part presentation titled "The Mirror," scheduled to premiere on Thursday, October 29, at 9/8c.

In this installment, character dynamics shift as Samantha is away in Australia for film work. Kyle steps in to assist Jay with managing the spirits at Woodstone Manor. Meanwhile, the household attempts to track down Pete, who remains missing months later. Additional plot threads involve Hetty reuniting with her estranged sister, Margaret, aided by a mysterious antique mirror, alongside a Halloween party thrown by Bela.

Broadcast and Streaming Options in the US

Viewers in the United States have multiple ways to access the broadcast and streaming release:

  • Live TV and Free Trials: The special broadcasts on CBS and can be viewed live via services offering free trial periods, such as Fubo or YouTube TV.
  • Paramount+: Subscribers to the Paramount+ Premium tier can stream the broadcast live. Those using the Paramount+ Essential tier can watch the episodes the day after they air.
  • Alternative Trials: The Walmart+ 30-day trial, priced at $1, includes the Paramount+ Essential tier as a member benefit.

International Availability

Availability varies by region for viewers outside the US:

  • Canada: The special is scheduled to release on Paramount+ in Canada on October 29, matching the US release date.
  • Australia and the UK: Specific release dates have not yet been officially announced, though the special is expected to land on Paramount+ in these regions eventually. UK viewers looking for alternatives can watch the UK version of the show on BBC iPlayer.

Practical Implications and Verification

Readers interested in verifying broadcast times, platform availability, subscription costs, or regional restrictions can check the original details directly through the [TechRadar Guide](https://www.techradar.com/entertainment/tv-shows/how-to-watch-ghosts-season-6-halloween-special).

Confirmed vs. Unknown Details

  • Confirmed: The release date (Thursday, October 29 at 9/8c), the title ("The Mirror"), plot premises involving Kyle, Jay, Pete, Hetty, Margaret, and Bela, and US viewing channels like CBS and Paramount+.
  • Unknown: Exact release dates for Australia and the UK remain unannounced.
